ITEM.PTXT: A 2WAY exhaust system has been adopted for the main muffler to improve exhaust efficiency and engine output while ensuring quietness. In the 2WAY exhaust system, a variable valve that adjusts the exhaust gas passage area according to exhaust gas pressure is provided inside the main muffler. The variable valve is kept closed by a return spring during idling and at low engine speeds.
By adopting a sub muffler with integrated catalyst on 4WD models, underfloor space has been secured and exhaust silencing effect has been improved.

ENTRY.PTXT: Since the exhaust gas pressure in the main muffler is low, the variable valve is closed, and the muffler functions as a muffler that emphasizes silencing to reduce booming noise.

When the exhaust gas pressure in the main muffler increases as the engine speed increases, the variable valve opens to enlarge the passage, and the muffler functions as a low back pressure, high output type muffler.
